The studio in Melbourne is dedicated to creating innovative [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]3d designs and illustrated stories through a combination of traditional methods and advanced technologies. Oddtoe's Mirth AI is paired up with a procedural 3d workflow to create advanced motion graphics used to power episodes of Oddtoe TV and a spoof of Apple's hit series, "Calls". Oddtoe's pipeline of creativity is not limited to the studio's own operations, however. The studio works in collaboration with other [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/4"][vc_column_text]studios and companies around the world to create co-productions. By leveraging its technological expertise, Oddtoe has been able to create complex animated stories for both television and film while collaborating on projects with major international producers. This round-the-clock and around-the-world collaboration allows Oddtoe to add a unique visual aesthetic and technical ability to productions from all corners of the globe. What Does Oddtoe Make in Melbourne?

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]Oddtoe continues the fine tradition of Australian design, visualization, & animation. Oddtoe is based out of Melbourne, Australia, with an additional presence in Los Angeles and Berlin. Oddtoe is at heart a visualizer and visual storyteller.

The studio in Melbourne is dedicated to creating innovative [/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][vc_column_text]3d designs and illustrated stories through a combination of traditional methods and advanced technologies. Utilizing a wide range of tools, from motion capture to scripting software, Oddtoe renders comedic visuals with a unique style and sense of humor. With the use of AI, Oddtoe can compete with larger (and more expensive) firms.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″][vc_column_text css=””]Oddtoe is the generative-AI animation and character-IP studio built by Data Arts Pty Ltd (ABN 79 617 357 016) since 2021, the Melbourne company also behind The Datalabs Agency, and this page covers the studio’s Melbourne base and the work made there.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/4″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column]
